The Treatment
What Is Microblading?
Redefine Your Brows. Redefine Yourself.

Microblading is a revolutionary semi-permanent eyebrow technique that creates the illusion of fuller, perfectly shaped brows using ultra-fine, hair-like strokes of cosmetic pigment. Unlike traditional eyebrow tattoos, microblading deposits pigment into the superficial layers of the skin, producing results that look remarkably natural â virtually indistinguishable from real brow hair.

At ISAAC Luxe, our microblading specialists work in close consultation with you to design a bespoke brow shape that perfectly complements your facial structure, bone symmetry, and personal aesthetic. A custom pigment blend is crafted to match your natural hair colour, and each hair-like stroke is meticulously etched by hand for an artisanal finish that no printed stencil can replicate.

"Microblading at ISAAC Luxe is not just a beauty treatment â it is a carefully crafted artform. Every stroke is placed with surgical precision to frame your face and restore confidence, one brow at a time."

The Science
How Microblading Works
The ISAAC Luxe Technique
Precision Â· Artistry Â· Personalisation

Manual Microblade Tool

A precise handheld tool fitted with a row of ultra-fine needles creates individual, hair-like strokes. The manual technique gives the artist full control over depth, pressure, and angle, resulting in strokes that mimic real brow hairs with incredible realism.

Semi-Permanent Pigment

Medical-grade, hypoallergenic pigments are deposited into the epidermal layer of the skin â not the deep dermis. This means results are semi-permanent, fading naturally over 12â18 months, and can be refreshed with a touch-up session for lasting perfection.

Bespoke Colour Matching

Every client receives a custom pigment blend formulated to match their natural brow colour, skin undertone, and hair texture. Our specialists ensure your brows look completely natural â never drawn on, never artificial â even up close.

Topical Numbing Cream

A medical-grade topical anaesthetic cream is applied to the brow area before the procedure begins, ensuring maximum comfort throughout. Most clients describe the sensation as a light scratching â minimal and very well tolerated.

Your Experience
The Procedure, Step by Step
What Happens During Your Session
A Guided Journey to Flawless Brows
1

Consultation & Brow Mapping

Your specialist begins with a thorough consultation to understand your desired brow shape, lifestyle, and skin type. Using professional brow mapping techniques, the ideal arch, width, length, and symmetry are drawn and reviewed before any procedure commences â your approval is paramount.

2

Pigment Selection & Colour Matching

A bespoke pigment blend is custom-formulated to perfectly complement your natural brow hair colour, skin tone, and undertone. We ensure the final result looks entirely natural â never overdone.

3

Numbing & Skin Preparation

A medical-grade topical numbing cream is applied to the eyebrow area and left to take effect for 20â30 minutes. The area is then cleansed and prepped under sterile conditions before the procedure begins.

4

Microblading â Hair-Stroke Application

Using a sterile, disposable microblade tool, our specialist etches ultra-fine, feather-light hair strokes into the skin in the direction of natural hair growth. Pigment is carefully implanted into each stroke, building up density and definition layer by layer.

5

Post-Procedure Review & Aftercare Guidance

Once the strokes are complete, the brows are reviewed together and any final refinements are made. You receive a comprehensive personalised aftercare kit and detailed instructions to ensure optimal healing and pigment retention.

6

Touch-Up Session (6â8 Weeks Later)

A mandatory follow-up touch-up is scheduled 6â8 weeks after the initial session. This appointment allows our specialist to assess healing, refine stroke density, adjust colour depth, and perfect the final result â ensuring brows that exceed expectations.

Choose Your Style
Brow Styles We Offer
Your Brows. Your Expression.

At ISAAC Luxe, we offer a range of microblading and semi-permanent brow styles â each tailored to your unique facial structure, hair type, and personal aesthetic vision.

Classic Microblading

Individual feather-light hair strokes etched by hand for a natural, defined brow. Ideal for sparse or over-plucked brows seeking a realistic, everyday look.

OmbrÃ© / Powder Brows

A soft, powdered gradient effect created with a machine technique. Gives a polished, make-up finish â lightest at the head and darkest at the tail. Long-lasting and ideal for oily skin types.

Combo Brows

The perfect blend of microblading at the front (fluffy hair strokes) and powder shading through the arch and tail. Best of both worlds â natural yet defined. Suitable for most skin types.

Nano Brows

Ultra-fine hair strokes created using a digital machine needle â thinner than classic microblading. Ideal for all skin types including oily skin, with longer retention and razor-sharp precision.

Microshading

A stippling technique using a cluster of tiny dots to create a soft, shaded brow with a powder-fill appearance. Great for clients who prefer a softer, less structured look with excellent coverage.

Brow Reconstruction

Specialised treatment for clients with alopecia, chemotherapy-related hair loss, or very sparse/absent brows. A full brow is rebuilt from scratch using advanced microblading and shading techniques.

Your Care Guide
Pre & Post Treatment Care

Following your pre and post care instructions is essential for achieving the best possible healed result. Please read these guidelines carefully and follow them diligently.

â¦ Before Your Session

Avoid alcohol, caffeine, or blood thinners 24 hours before your appointment.
Do not wax, thread, or tint brows for at least one week prior.
Discontinue Retin-A, AHA, or glycolic acid products near the brow area 2 weeks before.
Avoid chemical peels, microdermabrasion, or facials for 4 weeks before.
Avoid Botox in the forehead or brow area at least 4 weeks prior.
Stay out of direct sun and avoid tanning for one week before.
Arrive with brows drawn in your preferred shape if possible â this helps guide your specialist.

â¦ After Your Session

Do not get brows wet for the first 7â10 days (no swimming, saunas, or steam).
Gently cleanse the area morning and night with a mild, fragrance-free cleanser after day 2.
Apply the provided aftercare ointment with a clean cotton swab â do not over-apply.
Do not pick, peel, or scratch flaking skin â allow it to shed naturally.
Avoid makeup directly on brows during the healing period.
Avoid direct sun exposure; apply SPF 30+ on healed brows to prolong pigment life.
Attend your 6â8 week touch-up session for the perfect finished result.

Please Note: Brows will appear 20â30% darker immediately after the procedure. This is a completely normal part of the healing process. By week 4â6, your true, natural brow colour will emerge beautifully. Be patient â your dream brows are worth the wait.

Your Questions Answered
Frequently Asked Questions

Is microblading painful?

Microblading at ISAAC Luxe is performed with a medical-grade topical numbing cream applied for 20â30 minutes before the procedure. Most clients describe the sensation as a light scratching or mild pressure â very well tolerated. Discomfort is minimal and brief.

How long do microblading results last?

Results typically last 12â18 months depending on your skin type, lifestyle, and sun exposure. Oily skin types may see slightly faster fading. Annual or bi-annual touch-up sessions at ISAAC Luxe are recommended to maintain perfectly fresh, defined brows over time.

Is microblading safe for all skin types?

Microblading works best on normal to dry skin. For oily or combination skin types, our specialists may recommend Nano Brows, OmbrÃ© Powder Brows, or Combo Brows for better pigment retention and a longer-lasting result. Your consultation will determine the best technique for you.

How many sessions do I need?

Microblading is a two-part treatment. The initial session creates your new brows, and a mandatory touch-up session at 6â8 weeks perfects the colour, density, and shape after healing. Annual top-up sessions thereafter maintain beautiful, lasting results.

Can I wear makeup after microblading?

You should avoid applying any makeup directly on the brow area for the first 14 days after your procedure to allow proper healing and pigment settling. Once healed, you may wear makeup around the brows as normal â you will likely find you no longer want to fill them in!

What makes ISAAC Luxe microblading special?

At ISAAC Luxe, every microblading treatment is performed under the supervision of Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta's expert dermatology team using 100% sterile instruments, premium pigments, and a bespoke approach to brow design â ensuring medical-grade safety in a world-class luxury setting.
